title: Accelevation IPO Prices Below Range to Raise $540 Million
description: Accelevation Holdings Corp., a data center infrastructure company, and backer Olympus Partners raised $540 million in a US initial public offering priced below its marketed range, after a handful of first-time share sales were postponed.

title: Deloitte UK Partner Pay Grows to $1.5 Million on AI Demand
description: Deloitte’s UK business paid its equity partners an average of about £1.13 million ($1.5 million) last year, up 7% from the year prior as the firm said demand for advice on artificial intelligence drove profit.

title: MongoDB Not in a Rush to Find CEO Successor, Ittycheria Says
description: MongoDB Interim President and CEO Dev Ittycheria discusses the outlook for the company after Meta Platforms tapped former CEO Chirantan “CJ” Desai to lead a new AI platform for enterprise customers. He speaks on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
